principles.application: Space related items closer than unrelated items; preserve label-control closeness.
Treat same-role items similarly; ensure visually similar items behave consistently.
Use alignment and directional cues to support understandable reading sequences.
Allow simplified silhouettes for decoration but do not make essential instructions rely on guessing incomplete icons.
Make foreground versus background unambiguous and WCAG-compliant.
Elements moving together appear grouped; do not require motion to understand group membership.
